entities.summary: Ernesto Giobando, S.J. is an Argentine Catholic prelate who has served as an Auxiliary Bishop of Buenos Aires since 2014. He is a member of the Society of Jesus. Ernesto Giobando was a religious figures from Santa Fe (b. 1959-12-13, Santa Fe). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
